justification: Inspected byte-buddy-benchmark/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/benchmark/specimen/ExampleClass.java, ExampleInterface.java, and package-info.java. ExampleClass has no external imports; ExampleInterface and package-info only depend on net.bytebuddy.utility.nullability annotations. A repo-wide rg search shows net.bytebuddy.benchmark.specimen is only used by benchmark classes/tests in byte-buddy-benchmark (ClassByImplementationBenchmark, ClassByExtensionBenchmark, StubInvocationBenchmark, SuperClassInvocationBenchmark and their tests), while net.bytebuddy.utility.nullability is imported across many modules, so this package does not depend on a less stable package.
